name: Attendance Warning Trend Analysis
query:
SELECT
    MONTH(aw.warning_date) AS "Month:Int:80",
    YEAR(aw.warning_date) AS "Year:Int:80",
    emp.company AS "Company:Link/Company:120",
    emp.department AS "Department:Link/Department:120",

    -- Type Counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN aw.warning_type = 'Late Entry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Late Entry Count:Int:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN aw.warning_type = 'Early Exit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Early Exit Count:Int:150",
    SUM(CASE WHEN aw.warning_type = 'Absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Absent Count:Int:120",

    -- Total Warnings
    COUNT(*) AS "Combined Warning Count:Int:180",

    -- Status Counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN aw.state = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Approved Count:Int:140",
    SUM(CASE WHEN aw.state = 'Rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Rejected Count:Int:140",

    -- Rates
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN aw.state = 'Approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100,
        2
    ) AS "Approval Rate:Percent:130",

    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN aw.state = 'Rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)) * 100,
        2
    ) AS "Rejection Rate:Percent:130"

FROM `tabAttendance Warning` aw
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = aw.employee

WHERE
    aw.docstatus = 1

    -- Filters
    AND (%(company)s IS NULL OR %(company)s = '' OR emp.company = %(company)s)
    

GROUP BY
    YEAR(aw.warning_date),
    MONTH(aw.warning_date),
    emp.company,
    emp.department

ORDER BY
    YEAR(aw.warning_date) DESC,
    MONTH(aw.warning_date) DESC
